Pomegranate Lemonade
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 4:01am

Ingredients




2 cups fresh lemon, juice
cup pomegranate molasses or ¼ cup grenadine
1 juice of one blood orange
5 tablespoons super fine sugar
3 cups water





Preparation

1 In a pitcher, stir together all ingredients. Let lemonade chill in the refrigerator for an hour. Strain and serve over ice.
